args.body:
Hi David,

Welcome to Blue Sparrow Tech! My name is Emma Johnson, and I'm delighted to hear that you'll be joining our team in the marketing department.

I wanted to reach out personally to say how excited we are to have you on board. I'm sure you'll be a fantastic addition to the team, and I look forward to working with you and getting to know you better.

If you have any questions as you settle in, please don't hesitate to reach out. I'd be happy to help in any way I can.

Looking forward to meeting you soon!

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
